SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL C. & S. BR. REGIS... Station,
No. S. B. D. 122.
Date March 17, 19 31.
c.e 17 - 3 - 31.

Subject (in full) Mr. Fontenoy and G. Constantini.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Duncan.

Sir,

Mr. Fontenoy, residing at No. 27 Route
Ghisl, arrived in Shanghai from Paris where he was employed
with the "Havas" Newsagency. He was the founder and editor
of the "Journal de Shanghai" but resigned from the post
of editor and became adviser to the Minister of Communications,
of the National Government. He resigned from this position
about one year ago and became the representative of the
Newsagency A.R.I.P. (Agence de Renseignements Indo-Pacifique)
which position he still holds.

G. Constantini, lawyer, is associated
with E. Nouveau, Advocate, with offices at No. 29 Avenue
Edward VII. Nouveau is at present in France.

Whounean
D. S. I.

D. C. (C. & S. Branches)

File
M
18.3.31.

c.e 17 - 3 - 31.

事由（全称） Fontenoy先生与G. Constantini先生。

由副督察长邓肯（D.S.I. Duncan）撰写并呈送。

敬启者：

Fontenoy先生，居住于祁齐路（Route Ghisl）27号，从巴黎抵达上海，此前受雇于“哈瓦斯”（Havas）通讯社。他是《上海日报》（Journal de Shanghai）的创办人兼编辑，但已辞去编辑职务，转而担任国民政府交通部部长的顾问。约一年前，他辞去了该职位，成为A.R.I.P.通讯社（Agence de Renseignements Indo-Pacifique，印太情报社）的代表，目前仍担任此职。

G. Constantini，律师，与律师E. Nouveau有关联，其事务所位于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）29号。Nouveau目前身在法国。

Whounean
副督察长 (D. S. I.)

刑事与特别调查科科长 (D. C. (C. & S. Branches))

归档
M
1931年3月18日。

February 23, 1931.

CHINA THREATENS TO DEPORT FRENCH JOURNALIST.

The "Holmes", a mosquito paper, publishes
the following report:-
The Imperialists use to judge affairs in
China from evidence secured by hearsay and spread
exaggerated and groundless reports. This is an
insult to our country. This often happens in
imperialistic cases but it can also be found in
foreign publications in China.
Since the establishment of Nanking as
the capital, the national government has strictly
censored the foreign counter propaganda in which
it has been successful.
Recently the Central Propaganda Department
received secret information that the French Imperialists
have established in Paris an extensive news propaganda
organ called "Ha Hwa Correspondence Agency".
This agency makes a speciality of spreading rumours of
Chinese affairs and groundless reports of "Bolshevism"
"Yellow Danger", etc. It has branches at Peiping,
Tientsin, Shanghai and other ports and has appointed
Fontenoy, a French citizen, as its correspondent in
China.
The Central Propaganda Department has
requested the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to keep a
watch on the actions of Fontenoy and to warn him to
cease supplying the "Ha Hwa Correspondence Agency"
with untrue reports, otherwise he would be deported
from China.

pages.zh:
1931年2月23日。

中国威胁驱逐法国记者。

小报《Holmes》刊登了以下报道：
帝国主义者习惯根据道听途说的证据来评判中国事务，并散布夸大且毫无根据的报道。这是对我国的一种侮辱。这种情况在帝国主义案件中经常发生，但也见于在华的外国出版物中。
自南京定都以来，国民政府严格审查外国反宣传，并已取得成效。
最近，中央宣传部收到秘密情报，称法国帝国主义者已在巴黎建立了一个庞大的新闻宣传机构，名为“Ha Hwa Correspondence Agency”（哈华通讯社）。该机构专门散布关于中国事务的谣言以及关于“布尔什维主义”、“黄祸”等的无稽之谈。它在北平、天津、上海及其他港口设有分支机构，并任命法国公民Fontenoy为其驻华通讯员。
中央宣传部已要求外交部监视Fontenoy的行动，并警告他停止向“Ha Hwa Correspondence Agency”提供不实报道，否则将被驱逐出中国。

S2,
资料。有关中国的文章正由Chamberlain Constantinople寄往意大利。
这些做法是否也在此地施行？
(签名)

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
V. A. C. S.,
Mr. J. A. Fontenoy, editor of
the French daily newspaper "Le
Journal de Shanghai" arrived in
Shanghai about a year ago. He
speaks Russian fluently and
was an employee in a French
commercial firm in St. Petersburg
before the war. He returned to
Russia in 1924 as the "Havas"
representative at Moscow and remained
in Soviet Russia some three years.
Recently, he had the intention of
opening an English section of the Havas
agency in Shanghai, but according
to well-informed sources, he is about
to leave Shanghai as the revolution
and civil war in China are over.
He is considered to be an Alsatian
and his wife is Roumanian. He is
stated to favour the Hu Han Min
faction of the Koumintang. Since the
speech he delivered on Russia at
the Rotary Club, he states that

V. A. C. S.,
J. A. Fontenoy先生，法文日报《上海日报》（Le Journal de Shanghai）编辑，约于一年前抵达上海。他能流利地说俄语，战前曾在圣彼得堡的一家法国商号任职。1924年，他作为“哈瓦斯”社驻莫斯科代表返回俄国，并在苏维埃俄国停留了约三年。最近，他有意在上海开设哈瓦斯社的英文部，但据消息灵通人士称，鉴于中国的革命和内战已经结束，他即将离开上海。据称他是阿尔萨斯人，其妻子是罗马尼亚人。据说他倾向于国民党胡汉民派系。自从他在扶轮社发表关于俄国的演讲后，他表示
